Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE direct REAR source turnaround of the SAME M07 municipal crawler crane in STOWED TRAVEL pose. Image1 correct FRONT fixes physical sides, image2 correct right SIDE fixes complete stowed geometry, image3 source master for identity. Rotate this exact assembled object 180deg to view rear; do not redesign or rotate only upper carriage. Square 1024x1024 white, complete machine and margins, no other views/insets/text.
Same low teal/ivory/red engineering machine, TWO graphite crawler loops with teal long side cases, broad low central slewing chassis. Both track REAR ends toward viewer, rear bumper with service lights and tow lug, no road wheels or extra legs.
Rear counterweight is NEAREST: one broad ivory boxed ballast assembly with red corner blocks and rectangular panel divisions at rear of upper turntable, similar size/height and origin as image2 left-end ballast. It partially OCCLUDES cab and boom root. Cab is at VEHICLE RIGHT FRONT = REAR VIEWER RIGHT and FARTHER AWAY; only its rear/roof/side edges or small rear utility window visible around/above ballast. DO NOT paint a large front windscreen/grille facing backward. One cable winch/reel on VEHICLE LEFT = REAR VIEWER LEFT, correct red/graphite winding cylinder and hoses, not duplicate reel on both sides.
ONE boom is LOWERED HORIZONTAL and points FORWARD/AWAY FROM REAR VIEWER, aligned fore-and-aft with both tracks. In rear projection its long length is FORESHORTENED into depth; nearest visible part is compact rear root mounting and silver hydraulic/steel hinge frame. NO long SIDE beam spanning left-right across picture. No front pulley end/sheaves rotated toward rear camera. The hook is LOCKED in the FRONT travel bracket far away beside cab, so it is largely OCCLUDED in rear view; don't draw a free hook dangling behind ballast.
FOUR stabilizer outriggers stay fully folded alongside chassis above tracks, two each side. Rear pair's red/ivory folded pad ends may show at rear side housings, not deployed feet on ground. Keep all component counts and actual sides from image1/2. Palette teal major housings, ivory boom/ballast/cab, red structural brackets and restrained warning stripes, silver rods and black hoses. Same black ink/cel shading and light service wear. Direct rear, chassis and upper assembly point same forward direction, no front parts copied onto back, no humanoid head, guns, water tanks or second crane.
